contentText: It's hard to believe, but Christmas is just six weeks away. That means the battle of the Advent calendars is now well and truly underway. So if you love beauty products but are wanting to buy with safety and a healthy approach in mind, what do you do? Joining us from Atlanta is Lisa Fennessy, the founder and CEO of The New Knew, which reviews "clean beauty" products. She tells us what to look out for to take better care of our skin.
